question: What will be the closing value of NVIDIA (NVDA) stock (NVDA on Yahoo Finance) on August 25, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of NVDA on Yahoo Finance for 2026-08-25. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
baseline:
Computed by code from Yahoo Finance daily closes for NVDA: latest close 206.6400 on 2026-08-03.
Target date 2026-08-25 is 15 trading observations ahead. Percentiles of the price on the target date,
from the empirical distribution of 15-observation returns over the last 3 years (last year weighted double):

research:
I only used sources dated on or before 2026-08-04. Search results also returned later material, including how the earnings went and August prices, and I left all of it out.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-03: The last Yahoo Finance daily close in the code-collected data is **$206.64**. I could not fetch Yahoo directly. The question uses the NVDA Nasdaq close on Yahoo Finance for 2026-08-25, a Tuesday and a normal trading day. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/)
- Related Polymarket markets settle on the Pyth "Close" value, not Yahoo's, so small differences between the two are possible. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/nvda-above-in-august-2026)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The stock is at about $206.64, close to the middle of the 150-250 range, and 15 trading sessions remain.
- The key timing point: **Nvidia reports Q2 FY2027 results on 2026-08-26 after the close**, the day *after* the resolution date. The earnings jump itself will not be in the Aug 25 close, but positioning ahead of earnings will be. [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Sets-Conference-Call-for-Second-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-02: Motley Fool says NVDA was up only about 2% year to date against roughly 7% for the S&P 500, and calls the Aug 26 earnings a possible catalyst. I could not get the full text. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/02/prediction-nvidia-stock-will-skyrocket-on-aug-26/), [Nasdaq repost](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/prediction-nvidia-stock-will-skyrocket-aug-26)
- 2026-07-30: A secondary write-up confirms the Q2 call date. [aitoolly](https://aitoolly.com/en/ai-news/article/2026-07-30-nvidia-schedules-conference-call-for-second-quarter-fiscal-year-2027-financial-results)
- 2026-07-29: Nvidia announced the Q2 FY2027 call for Aug 26, 2pm PT. The quarter ended July 26. [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Sets-Conference-Call-for-Second-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx)
- Around 2026-07-29: Trading Economics reported NVDA fell to about $191.13, its lowest level since June 2026. The stock has since recovered about 8% to $206.64. [Trading Economics](https://tradingeconomics.com/nvda:us/news/570803)
- 2026-07-18: According to a German outlet, US officials described H200 shipments to China as "negligible" and said know-your-customer talks had stalled. The same piece mentions a buyback authorization of about €80B and an average analyst target of about €264. [boerse-express](https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/nvidia-aktie-rubin-transition-gegen-chart-schwaeche-929621)
- Undated: Rubin production is expected to ramp in the second half of 2026. [boerse-express](https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/nvidia-aktie-rubin-transition-gegen-chart-schwaeche-929621)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-08-03: This is the code-computed empirical distribution of 15-session returns over 3 years, with the last year weighted double. Percentiles for the price on Aug 25:

  | Percentile | Price |
  |---|---|
  | p5 | $184.0 |
  | p10 | $190.1 |
  | p25 | $199.6 |
  | p50 | $211.3 |
  | p75 | $224.3 |
  | p90 | $241.0 |
  | p95 | $250.1 |

  The middle 50% band is about -3.4% to +8.5%. The median sits above spot because of NVDA's historical upward drift.
- Recent trend: the stock has moved sideways to slightly down for the year (about +2% YTD according to Fool). It swung from a late-July low of about $191 back to about $207, so roughly 8% in a week, which matches the width of the base-rate band.
- Since earnings fall after the target date, implied volatility over Aug 4-25 should mostly reflect non-earnings volatility. Pre-earnings run-ups or drawdowns are common.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket lists NVDA "close above X" markets, including Aug 25, Aug 21 and an end-of-August series. The only odds I could see came from unofficial mirror sites, the snapshots were undated and contradicted each other, and liquidity was tiny. I could not verify current odds as of Aug 4. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/nvda-above-in-august-2026), [struct.to Aug 25 >215](https://explorer.struct.to/markets/nvda-close-above-215-on-august-25-2026)
- Analyst targets: the only figure I found was the average of about €264 cited by boerse-express. I found no Kalshi or Manifold market for this specific date.

## 6. Upcoming events before Aug 25
- Early to mid August: CPI and PPI reports for July (dates not confirmed), and earnings from other AI and semiconductor companies.
- Around Aug 20-22: the Fed's Jackson Hole symposium (2026 dates not confirmed).
- Any news on China and H200 export policy, tariffs or semiconductor trade.
- The run-up to the Aug 26 earnings report. The report itself comes after the resolution date.
